actual: C-010-DIAG-02 proves 1,073 exact symbol/date cases are all PIT eligible_start events (955 ipo_365d, 118 st_restore). All have authoritative positive causal daily_basic.circ_mv before t, but PostgresStockFactReader rejects every source date earlier than the current PIT span eligible_start while A2 includes the entrant in P/F and requires finite weights. This creates structural denominator failure across 990 L1 and 1,049 L2 sector/date entries. Repair must preserve PIT membership, hard semantic authority and no-lookahead; no current-day/future/zero/default fill, no symbol exclusion, no HMM/selection/D6/model/READY.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
